name: Central Pollution Control Board
description: National apex body for pollution control; administers EPR portals (plastic, e-waste, battery) and sets national policy under HWM/BMW Rules.

name: State Pollution Control Board
description: State-level operational authority issuing CTE/CTO consents and Rule 6/Rule 10 authorizations, the primary regulator for most CPCB-administered obligations.

name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
description: Administers the Environment (Protection) Act 1986, the umbrella statute enabling every subordinate CPCB rule.

name: Central Ground Water Authority
description: Issues groundwater extraction No-Objection Certificates and receives periodic bore-well compliance reporting.

name: Urban Local Body
description: Municipal authority overseeing Solid Waste Management and Construction & Demolition Waste Management Rules compliance.
